entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The order's data reached the platform, before the warehouse has the goods.

entries.wording: CHINA, GUANGZHOU, ARRIVAL AT OUTWARD OFFICE OF EXCHANGE
entries.note: The warehouse's receipt, worded as a post's: the country and city lead, so any city reads the same.

entries.wording: 货物离开操作中心
entries.note: The warehouse's departure: the goods leave the operation centre.

entries.wording: 【CN】您的订单预计3.25开船，4.9到港，船名航次：HANSA DUBURG/2603E
entries.note: The forwarder's note of the planned sailing, arrival and vessel; the dates and vessel change, so any such note reads the same.

entries.wording: 【CN】您的订单已开船，船期预计4.9到港
entries.note: The forwarder's note that the ship sailed, with its expected arrival.

entries.wording: 【US】您的订单已到港，等待清关卸船
entries.note: The ship reached the US port; clearance and unloading come next, a routine step, not a hold.

entries.wording: 【US】您的订单已提柜，等待拆柜
entries.note: The container was collected from the port and waits to be unpacked.

entries.wording: 【US】您的订单已交服务商，请留意提取信息！
entries.note: Handed to the US delivery carrier, whose rows follow.

entries.wording: 过机扫描入库(广州设备)
entries.note: The platform's script: scanned into the Guangzhou warehouse. The script's rows are written ahead, so they are named, not kept as scans.

entries.wording: 运单已确认
entries.note: The platform's script: waybill confirmed.

entries.wording: 计划配载
entries.note: The platform's script: stowage planned.

entries.wording: 完成配载
entries.note: The platform's script: stowage done.

entries.wording: 已开船
entries.note: The platform's script: the ship sailed.

entries.wording: 运输中..
entries.note: The platform's script: in transit.

entries.wording: 货件信息已发送给 FedEx
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: the label's data reached FedEx, which delivers the last leg.

entries.wording: 已收取
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: picked up from the forwarder's US warehouse, a hand-over after the forwarder's own acceptance.

entries.wording: 抵达 FedEx 服务站
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: arrived at a FedEx facility.

entries.wording: 货件将准时送达
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: on schedule for delivery.

entries.wording: 已离开 FedEx 服务站
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: left a FedEx facility.

entries.wording: 途中
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: on the way.

entries.wording: 抵达当地 FedEx 服务站
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: at the local FedEx facility before the delivery run.

entries.wording: 已装上 FedEx 车辆等待递送
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: on the FedEx vehicle for delivery.

entries.wording: 已送达,放在前门处。  不要求签收服务。
entries.note: Copied from FedEx: delivered and left at the front door, no signature required; where FedEx left it changes, so any such row reads the same.
